   Planning Division
  Memorandum

  To:  Planning Commission

  From:  Norma Hernandez, Assistant Planner

  Date:  January 9, 2024

  Re:  Item No. 3 – CUP No. 868 for 9524 Rayo Avenue

  A. Compliance Review for CUPs for alcohol licenses
  Pursuant to SGMC Section 11.42.070(B)(8), a conditional use permit (CUP) for an Alcoholic Beverage
  License (ABC) is “subject to compliance review of the property and CUP conditions at planning-
  commission-established intervals; the first compliance review shall occur within six months of permit
  issuance or actuation.”

  B. Conditional Use Permit No. 868 at 9524 Rayo Avenue – “La Champita” Restaurant
  The Planning Commission conditioned CUP No. 868 with a requirement to provide a compliance review
  of the requested ABC License within three months of the CUP approval. CUP No. 868 was approved on
  July 18, 2023.

  On October 17, 2023, the Planning Commission conducted a compliance review of CUP No. 868 and
  requested additional information, including the number of calls for service to the Police Department.
  Additionally, a second compliance review was requested to a date certain of January 16, 2024. Thus, on
  January 10, 2024 a letter was mailed to all property owners and occupants that are located within a
  1000-foot radius of the subject restaurant, informing them of the scheduled compliance review.

Attachment:  Letter mailed to property owners and occupants

January 8, 2024

Re: Conditional Use Permit No. 868 at 9524 Rayo Avenue

Dear Property Owner, Resident, Business Owner or Occupant:

On July 5, 2023, the City’s Planning Commission approved Conditional Use Permit No. 868, which was a request for
a Type 41 – Alcoholic Beverage Control License for an existing restaurant, “La Champita,” located at 9524 Rayo
Avenue. The Planning Commission conditioned the permit with a compliance review of three (3) months from the
approval date (July 5, 2023).

On October 17, 2023, the Planning Commission requested to conduct a second compliance review of conditional
use permit number 868 on January 16, 2023.

This letter is to inform you that the Planning Commission with be conducting a COMPLIANCE REVIEW of Conditional
Use Permit No. 868 on January 16,2024 at 6:30 PM.

Location:  Council Chamber at South Gate City Hall
  8650 California Avenue
  South Gate, California 90280

  Or

  Members of the public wishing to observe the meeting virtually may join through a Call-In Conference.
  For the updated Dial-In Number and Conference Code for the Planning Commission meeting, please
  visit the City’s website at www.cityofsouthgate.org/AgendaCenter.

Should you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me at 323.563.9514 or via email at
planninginfo@sogate.org.

Sincerely,

Norma A. Hernandez

8 de enero del 2024

Re: Conditional Use Permit No. 868 - 9524 Rayo Avenue

Estimado propietario, residente, propietario de negocio u ocupante:

El 5 de julio de 2023, la Comisión de Planificación de la Ciudad aprobó el Permiso de Uso Condicional No. 868, que
era una solicitud de Licencia de Control de Bebidas Alcohólicas Tipo 41 para un restaurante existente, “La
Champita”, ubicado en 9524 Avenida Rayo. La Comisión de Planificación condicionó el permiso a una revisión de
cumplimiento de tres (3) meses a partir de la fecha de aprobación (5 de julio de 2023).

El 17 de octubre del 2023, la Comisión de Planificación solicitó realizar una segunda revisión de cumplimiento del
permiso condicional numero 868 el 16 de enero de 2023.

Esta carta es para informarle que la Comisión de Planificación llevará a cabo una revisión de cumplimiento del
Permiso de Uso Condicional No. 868 el 16 de enero del 2024 a las 6:30 p.m.

Ubicación: Cámara del Consejo en el Ayuntamiento de South Gate (Council Chambers)
  8650 Avenue California
  South Gate, California 90280

  conferencia telefónica. Para obtener el número de acceso telefónico y el código de conferencia

Atentamente,
